description: This file contains unit tests for the RsaSsaPssVerifier class, testing RSA signature verification including cases with valid signatures, invalid signatures, different keys, and public metadata support.

classes.name: RsaSsaPssVerifierTestWithPublicMetadata
classes.description: A parameterized test fixture class for testing RSA PSS verifier with public metadata support.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test parameters and keys before each test.

methods.name: VerifierWorksWithPublicMetadata
methods.description: Tests that the verifier correctly verifies signatures with correct public metadata.

methods.name: VerifierFailsToVerifyWithWrongPublicMetadata
methods.description: Ensures verification fails when using incorrect public metadata.

methods.name: VerifierFailsToVerifyWithEmptyPublicMetadata
methods.description: Checks that verification fails with empty public metadata.

methods.name: VerifierFailsToVerifyWithoutPublicMetadataSupport
methods.description: Verifies that verification fails if public metadata support is not enabled.

methods.name: EmptyMessageEmptyPublicMetadataVerificationSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful verification with empty message and empty public metadata.
